intro x
have h1 : 0 < Real.log √x := by rw [Real.log_pos]; exact (Real.pos_sqrt x).trans (hx.trans (by norm_num))
have h2 : Real.log √x = Real.log x / 2 := by rw [Real.log_sqrt, Real.log_eq]
let l := Real.log x
let m := Real.log √x
have h3 : m = l / 2 := h2
have h4 : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / m + √x :=
  by apply Real.primeCounting_bound; exact (Real.log_pos.mpr h1)
exact h4
